for i = 0, #a do table_values[i] = {[0] = i} end
    for j = 0, #b do table_values[0][j] = j end
    for i = 1, #a do
        for j = 1, #b do
            local cost = a:sub(i, i) == b:sub(j, j) and 0 or 1
            table_values[i][j] = math.min(table_values[i - 1][j] + 1, table_values[i][j - 1] + 1,
                table_values[i - 1][j - 1] + cost)
